indications: bipolar I/II maintenance (first-line, strongest anti-suicide evidence)

dosing.adult: 400-800 mg/day (carbonate) depending on indication; start low (200-400 mg/day in older adults or when minimizing ADRs is a priority), titrate every 3-7 days based on serum level and response

after_initiation.lithium_level: 1 week after starting/any dose change, then weekly until stable

baseline_before_start: pregnancy test in women of childbearing potential

items: lithium level (12 h after last dose)
schedule_6_months.interval: every 6 months (3 months if risk factors: age >65, renal disease, interacting drugs, unstable thyroid)

monitoring.summary: Level+renal+TSH+Ca: weekly until stable -> then every 3-6 months (6 months routine, 3 months high risk). NICE: level/renal/TSH/Ca at 6 months, then 6-monthly; eGFR must also be checked annually minimum
